milestone: X78.39A — Class-Separated Creator Funding Queue Telemetry

backfill.duplicate_policy: NOT EXISTS followed by handoff conflict protection

retry.identity: same logical primary key; not a new organic obligation

stale_running.identity: same logical primary key; not a new obligation

current_metric_limitation: source is mutable and retry/status transitions are not event-sourced. Existing cumulative queue rows cannot reconstruct class-created, claimed, completed, retried, reactivated and expired event counts per interval.
implementation: none; no telemetry schema was deployed because it would require atomic producer/consumer event writes and an audited deployment window
